title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problem: A recommendation system needs to find the top K highly rated items from a stream of user ratings. The rating data is stored in an array nums, and the integer k represents the desired K-th highest rating. Please implement a streaming algorithm that, while processing ratings from nums one by one, can query the current K-th highest rating at any time, and returns the final K-th highest rating after all data is processed.
strategy: Maintain a min-heap of capacity k, where the top of the heap is the current k-th largest.
learning_objectives: Understand how a min-heap maintains state in TopK problems, explain why the heap top is the K-th largest element.
Be able to predict the heap change after adding the next element based on the current heap state.
Master the impact of push and pop operations on the candidate set size and heap top.

interaction_tasks.feedback_correct: Correct! After push and pop, the heap maintains capacity k, and the heap top becomes the k-th largest.
interaction_tasks.feedback_wrong: Note that when the heap is full, pushing a new element may trigger a pop. Observe the heap size after push.
interaction_tasks.oracle: Based on the next state in the trace, check if the heap is [5, 6] and the heap top is 5.
interaction_tasks.prompt: Current heap contents are [4, 5], k=2, next element is 6. After pushing 6, what will the heap become? What will be the heap top?
interaction_tasks.stage2_affordance: Drag numbers into the heap to observe the automatic maintenance process.

interaction_tasks.prompt: What invariant property does the heap size have across all steps?
